subject: [hw] IP -> D01: two host-verified iOS build facts (SDK path, vcodecd link surface)
body:
Two facts for FACTS.md, both [V] on this tree today; no phone.

[V] 1. The iPhoneOS16.5 SDK exists at <work>/gpu/build/apple-toolchain/sdks/iPhoneOS16.5.sdk (N2_IOS_SDK overrides). IVs host/Makefile uses it when <SDK>/usr/include exists and then `make -C gpu/hwcodec/host ios-lib OUT=<dir>` compiles 33/33 objects and writes <dir>/ios/libn2vhost.a with llvm-ar (BSD index) for arm64-apple-ios16.0. The gpu/video/sdk/sysinc fallback cannot cover setjmp/fenv/mman/sched and compiles only 20/33. Evidence: command output, host/Makefile:52-71,152-159.

[V] 2. Linking vcodecd for arm64-apple-ios16.0 against that archive needs the gpu/video libSystem stub plus 100+ supplemental libSystem symbols (ioctl, pthread_*, fclose/fopen, mmap, sigsetjmp/siglongjmp, fenv, exp2/log, etc.); I checked every one as an export token of the SDKs own usr/lib/libSystem.tbd. With a P03-shaped n2vc_hw_open_dev the product links: vcodecd 272304 bytes, no undefined symbols. Without P03 the only unresolved product symbol is _n2vc_hw_open_dev. Evidence: gpu/hwcodec/daemon/sdk_symbols.txt, build_ios.sh link-check output, /tmp build only.

Not a fact for FACTS (my choice, not hardware): HELLO max is 4096x2160. No other change requested.
